description: This Java class, ShareAccountDataSerializer, provides serialization and validation logic for share account data within a financial application. It handles JSON parsing, validation of input parameters, creation and updating of ShareAccount objects, and manages charges, transactions, and account status changes. It acts as a crucial component for processing API requests related to share accounts, including creation, updates, approval, rejection, activation, redemption, addition of shares, and closure.

classes.name: ShareAccountDataSerializer
classes.description: Provides serialization, deserialization, validation, and business logic operations for ShareAccount entities, including handling JSON input/output, account state transitions, and charge processing within the application.

methods.name: validateAndCreate
methods.description: Validates JSON input data to create a new ShareAccount instance, parsing parameters, checking business constraints, and assembling related charges and transactions.

methods.name: validateAndUpdate
methods.description: Validates JSON input to update properties of an existing ShareAccount, handling parameter changes and recalculating related details.

methods.name: validateAndApprove
methods.description: Validates and approves a share account based on submitted JSON data, updating account status and recalculating charges.

methods.name: validateAndUndoApprove
methods.description: Reverts an approved account back to pending status, updating charges accordingly.

methods.name: validateAndReject
methods.description: Rejects a share account, possibly with reasons, updating account status.

methods.name: validateAndActivate
methods.description: Activates a previously approved share account, updating status and handling associated charges.

methods.name: validateAndClose
methods.description: Closes a share account, ensuring all transactions are valid and updating account status and charges.

methods.name: validateAndApplyAddtionalShares
methods.description: Validates and processes requests to add additional shares to an existing account, including charge calculations.

methods.name: validateAndApproveAdditonalShares
methods.description: Handles approval of additional shares purchase requests, updating total shares and charges.

methods.name: validateAndRejectAdditonalShares
methods.description: Handles rejection of additional share purchase requests, adjusting pending amounts.

methods.name: validateAndRedeemShares
methods.description: Validates and processes redemption of shares, including lock-in period checks and charge application.
